name: Filinoa
source:
She is the Queen's consort, third in rank.

After an accident, she was discovered by Celecia, she is now a warrior queen.

Her dream is to marry a gentleman who is stronger than her. She older than everyone but Silvia.

[From [url=http://www.terra.dti.ne.jp/~f-rui/works/myworks/mahara_simai/sisters_top.html]official site[/url]]
